dogecoin.text:
At this point, #dogecoin is no longer about profits to me. I've made enough already.

It's about principles. I want to see that meme coin called #DOGE get to a dollar, and then 10, and then the moon 🚀🚀

#dogetothemoon #dogearmy https://t.co/0iEdccP7Ok

I believe in $DOGE and in the power of its community, but I don't see it as an investment.

I see it as a movement I'm glad to forever be a part.

Our community was built on the fact that DOGE is cheap, accessible to and affordable for everyone.
